content: WhatsApp Business Cloud API enforces a 24-hour customer service window: the timer opens when the END USER messages/calls the business and resets on each new user message. Inside the window a business may send free-form (service) messages. Outside it, per Meta docs: 'When the window closes, you can only send pre-approved template messages.' Business-initiated outreach must use approved MARKETING/UTILITY/AUTHENTICATION templates. Verified against developers.facebook.com Cloud API send-messages guide. This is a HARD BLOCKER for unsolicited alert push on official Cloud API. Group messaging via Cloud API Groups API exists (Oct 2025+) but requires Official Business Account, caps at 8 participants, and is gated to businesses with 100k+ monthly business-initiated conversations. Unofficial bridges (Baileys/WAHA/Evolution API) have no 24h window and do support groups, but violate WhatsApp ToS with rising account-ban risk.
